result.rationale: The diff changes `evt.destinationCalendar?.integration` to `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? []; ... mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` without optional chaining. When destinationCalendar is null/empty, destructure yields undefined, so `.integration` throws TypeError on exactly the path (Google Meet location, no destination calendar) where the fallback to Daily video should trigger. Verifiable directly from the EventManager.ts hunk.

judged_text: The array migration drops the optional chaining on the Meet fallback: `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` is evaluated without `?.` after `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? []`, so it crashes with TypeError exactly on the path the fallback exists for. A booking with location 'integrations:googlemeet' and no destinationCalendar (eventType and organizer have none — the exact scenario the 'Fallback to Cal Video' branch was written for) throws `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'integration')` instead of degrading to Daily video, turning a bookable flow into a 500.
